translations.web: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
translations.bsb: save others by snatching them from the fire; and to still others show mercy tempered with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
translations.kjv: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
